result.situation: CASE-1108: brand Humira for RA pended NF-PREF on 2026-10-13. The payer needs documented failure or intolerance of preferred adalimumab-adaz. Two provider records disagree on whether the biosimilar was ever tried. 110h left; window closes 2026-10-23 23:59.

criteria.criterion: Diagnosis: RA documented by a rheumatologist
criteria.evidence: PA form lists RA M06.9 by a rheumatologist; prescriber specialty is Rheumatology.
Dr. Priya Natarajan, Rheumatology, Lakeside Arthritis Center.

criteria.criterion: Step therapy: methotrexate ≥15 mg/wk for ≥12 weeks with inadequate response, or contraindication/intolerance
criteria.evidence: Both provider records show methotrexate 15 mg/wk from 06/2023 to 03/2024, inadequate response.

criteria.criterion: Non-preferred product: documented trial and failure or intolerance of adalimumab-adaz, with date and nature (formulary exception)
criteria.evidence: The PA form says adalimumab-adaz was used in 2025 and stopped for injection reactions, but gives no specific dates. The chart notes say the patient was biologic-naive before Humira (03/2025) with no other TNF inhibitors.

conflicts.description: The PA form says adalimumab-adaz was tried in 2025 and stopped for injection reactions. The chart notes say the patient was biologic-naive before Humira 03/2025 with no other TNF inhibitors. The operator note flags the same contradiction.
conflicts.resolution: Unresolved. Both are tier-3 provider records, so the hierarchy cannot settle it. Escalate to the Team Lead and get clarifying records from the provider office.

missing_information.item: Provider records of any adalimumab-adaz trial: administration dates and description of the injection reactions
missing_information.why_it_matters: Criterion 4 requires the date and nature of failure or intolerance. Without it, a formulary exception cannot be supported.
missing_information.how_to_get: Records request to Lakeside Arthritis Center (Dr. Natarajan's office), e.g. dispensing history and the visit note documenting the reaction.

missing_information.item: Prescriber clarification of which record is correct
missing_information.why_it_matters: The PA form and chart notes contradict each other on the biosimilar trial.
missing_information.how_to_get: Ask the office to confirm the med history in writing, per Team Lead direction.

missing_information.item: Whether the prescriber will switch the request to preferred adalimumab-adaz if no trial occurred
missing_information.why_it_matters: The policy offers no continuity-of-care exemption. Switching is the payer's stated alternative.
missing_information.how_to_get: Prescriber decision, raised by the Team Lead or the provider office.

E1.reason: The open question is factual (was the biosimilar tried?), not interpretive. Re-check if the provider confirms injection reactions (DOC-1108-01): Clinical Intelligence may need to judge whether they qualify as intolerance.

E2.reason: Provider records disagree on whether the patient tried and reacted to adalimumab-adaz: DOC-1108-01 says yes, DOC-1108-02 says biologic-naive. Neither settles it; NOTE-1 flags it.

E3.reason: No message claims a rule change. POLICY bulletin BP-B-2026-08 only announces a Q1 2027 formulary review with no criteria changes.

E4.reason: System facts show 110h left (not under 48h), with the window closing 2026-10-23 23:59 per CASE.

E5.reason: CASE shows a first submission (submission_count 1) and status PENDED, not a second denial.

E6.reason: No patient safety concern appears in CASE, DOC-1108-01, DOC-1108-02 or NOTE-1.

result.action_rationale: NF-PREF would default to a formulary exception, or a records request if criteria are undocumented. But E2 fires: the provider records contradict each other on the biosimilar trial. SOP §4 step 5 requires escalation before any payer-facing action. Criteria 1-3 are met; criterion 4 is unknown.
parallel_actions: Send a records request to Lakeside Arthritis Center for adalimumab-adaz administration dates and reaction documentation, or written confirmation the patient was biologic-naive.
Follow up with the office at 48h if there is no response (SOP §7).
Track the window: escalate again for an extension if under 48h remain without resolution.
could_not_determine: Whether adalimumab-adaz was actually tried, when, and what the reaction was.
needs_human_judgment: Team Lead: how to resolve the conflicting provider records, and whether to raise switching to the preferred product with the prescriber.
Clinical Intelligence (if the trial is confirmed): whether the documented injection reactions qualify as intolerance under criterion 4.

draft.subject: CASE-1108: conflicting provider records on biosimilar trial (Humira NF-PREF pend)
draft.body:
CASE-1108 (PT-64890, brand Humira 40 mg q2w for RA, Bluepeak Commercial) was pended NF-PREF on 2026-10-13. Bluepeak needs documented trial and failure or intolerance of preferred adalimumab-adaz, with date and nature, for a formulary exception. The policy has no continuity-of-care exemption.

The provider records conflict. The PA form (received 10/07) says adalimumab-adaz was used in 2025 and stopped for injection reactions, with no dates. The chart notes (faxed 10/16) say the patient was biologic-naive before starting Humira in 03/2025, with no other TNF inhibitors. Diagnosis, prescriber and methotrexate step criteria are met.

Decision needed: how to resolve the conflict, and whether to ask Dr. Natarajan to switch to adalimumab-adaz if no trial occurred. I am sending a records request to Lakeside Arthritis Center in parallel. The window closes 2026-10-23 23:59 (about 110h left). Holding all payer submissions until you respond.

operator_summary.headline: Hold the case and escalate to your Team Lead
why: Provider records disagree on whether the preferred biosimilar was ever tried.
Payer requires documented biosimilar failure; no exemption for patients stable on Humira.
About 110 hours remain, so there is time to resolve it.
then: Request biosimilar trial records from Lakeside Arthritis Center.
Follow up with the office in 48 hours.
Submit nothing to the payer until the Team Lead answers.

triggers_fired.reason: Provider records disagree on whether the patient tried and reacted to adalimumab-adaz: DOC-1108-01 says yes, DOC-1108-02 says biologic-naive. Neither settles it; NOTE-1 flags it.
